item.title: Neuron Flame v1.74 — Dynamic Island recorder, brand cleanup, direct DMG download
item.description:
The recorder pill now lives at the top of the screen, hugging the physical notch on Apple Silicon laptops. Brand-tinted breathing halo while recording. The whole site shipped with comparison + use-case landing pages and a direct DMG download.

Read more on GitHub or download the DMG.
